mapper.select: SELECT t.id AS id, u.name AS name, u.profile_image AS profileImg, COUNT(DISTINCT pp.client_id) AS memberCount, MAX( CASE s.type WHEN 'YOGA' THEN '요가' WHEN 'HYPERTROPHY' THEN '근비대' WHEN 'BODY' THEN '보디빌딩' WHEN 'STRENGTH' THEN '스트렝스' WHEN 'REHABILITATION' THEN '재활' ELSE '' END ) AS mainSpecial FROM TRAINER t JOIN `USER` u ON t.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN PT_PACKAGE pp ON t.id = pp.trainer_id AND (pp.expires_at IS NULL OR pp.expires_at >= NOW()) LEFT JOIN TRAINER_SPECIALIZATION s ON t.id = s.trainer_id WHERE t.gym_id = #{value} AND t.approval_status = 'APPROVED' GROUP BY t.id, u.name, u.profile_image ORDER BY t.id DESC
